insult: Ye grog-bellied sycophant, thy sawce is thin as broth and thy wit is flat as stale ale.
Ye crusty-backed bottle-jack, thy manners are rough as a tavern brawl and thy words as hollow as a drained tankard.
Ye leaky grog-hound, thy sawce is vinegar and thy heart is grog-sour.
Ye grog-bellied sawce-box prater, thy grog is watered, thy pride is soured, and thy bottle is cracked.
Ye crusty-backed taproom parasite, thou bowest so low thy nose scrapes the sawdust of the taproom floor for a groat.
Ye leaky crusty cur, thou art a leaky bottle of sawdust wit pouring flattery on every fool.
Ye grog-bellied dunghill toad, thy tongue wags like a loose sawce-ladle while thy brains swim in dregs.
Ye crusty-backed swill-bowl sycophant, thy pride is crusty as stale bread and thy grog is flat as a pancake.
Ye leaky sycophant, thy crusty hide hath known more grog than grace and more bottle than brain.
Ye grog-bellied bottle-jack, thy honor is a cracked bottle fit only for swill.
Ye crusty-backed grog-hound, thou spoutest sawce borrowed from better men's grog-casks.
Ye leaky sawce-box prater, thou art a corked bottle full of nothing but wind and flat ale.
Ye grog-bellied taproom parasite, thy head is an empty cask corked with vanity.
Ye crusty-backed crusty cur, thy head is a hollow cask leaking sawce upon the honest man's table.
Ye leaky dunghill toad, thy sawce is over-salted and thy wit is under-baked.
Ye grog-bellied swill-bowl sycophant, thy wit is crusty mold upon a grog-cask.
Ye crusty-backed sycophant, thy wit is foam upon the grog and thy honor is the dregs at the bottom.
Ye leaky bottle-jack, thou art a froth of falsehood floating upon the grog.
Ye grog-bellied grog-hound, thy heart is pickled in sour grog and thy soul is crusty rot.
Ye crusty-backed sawce-box prater, thou reekest of the bottle and of the sycophant's kiss.
